correctness.rationale: For every integer k>=1, C_k(u,v)=uv+(1/8k)u(1-u)[4v(1-v)]^k has uniform margins and c_k=1+eps(1-2u)f'_k with |f'_k|<=4k; consequently c_k lies in [1/2,3/2]. The conditional CDF v+eps(1-2u)f_k(v) decreases in u for interior v, establishing strict stochastic increase, while C-uv>=0 yields PQD. Directly integrating its squared conditional-CDF deviation gives xi(C_k)=2 eps^2 I_k, I_k=4^(2k)((2k)!)^2/(4k+1)!. Four actual quadrant masses [[(1+eps)/4,(1-eps)/4],[(1-eps)/4,(1+eps)/4]] yield a piecewise-linear checkerboard conditional CDF and xi(B_k)=eps^2/2. Hence the exact ratio 1/(4I_k) diverges like sqrt(k/(2*pi)); dominated convergence supplies the infinite result. Independently evaluated rational beta integrals, checkerboard matrix and k=5,6 threshold; I5=262144/969969, I6=4194304/16900975. k6 ratio=16900975/16777216. These finite calculations do not replace the asymptotic proof; absolute inflation tends to zero.
